MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p, date_diff('year', CAST(strptime(p.birth_date, '%Y/%m/%d') AS DATE), DATE('2026-10-14')) AS age
WHERE age > 42
   OR p.name <> 'Fran Curran Francis Hugh Curran Sr.'
   OR p.name = 'Dewayne "D. J." White, Jr.'
   OR CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) = 1
RETURN p.olympic_gold_medals AS col1, p.college AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
